deploymentIdentitySource: Release identifiers supplied by the lead reviewer; this task independently verifies live content equality, not the provider deployment API.
method: Read each exact release file, fetch corresponding production URL with no-cache request header, SHA-256 hash decoded response bytes, compare length and digest; rehash release asset after fetch to detect concurrent changes. Six concurrent read-only workers; no media fetches or browser student-state changes.
limits: Equality proves the requested served text assets match this release snapshot. It does not revalidate video payloads, all HTML files, provider deployment metadata, business correctness or end-user playback behavior.
